$description: ohmtools tokens that do not change with light and dark mode. Generated outputs: npm run build.

sans.$description: The only typeface, for text and headings alike. Bundled with the app (@fontsource-variable/inter), never loaded from a CDN.

base.$description: shadcn's --radius. base-sera draws every control with square corners (rounded-none), so UI corners are 0; kept because shadcn components derive their radius scale from it.

divider.$description: The spacing unit around every divider line, on both sides.

tint.$description: Tints of primary for data told apart by colour (one per timetable, series, category). Step n: lightness - n * lightness-step, chroma - n * chroma-step (at least chroma-min), hue unchanged; after steps the ramp starts over. Text on a tint is primary-foreground.
